title: cross-sdk compact retry facade and streaming ergonomics parity
author: Lena Morales
release_notes: Introduce a compact RetryFacade shared across Python/TS/Go SDKs to standardize backoff/timeout defaults and streaming reconnect ergonomics; minor API surface additions but backward-compatible shims provided; SDK versions bumped (py 1.9.0, ts 2.7.1, go 1.8.0).
description: Motivation: customer teams reported inconsistent retry behavior and awkward streaming ergonomics across the three SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go). This PR introduces a compact, language-agnostic RetryFacade and a set of consumer-friendly streaming helpers to bring parity and reduce surprise behavior when switching SDKs. Summary of changes: 1) New RetryFacade: a small interface that centralizes retry policy composition (preset names, jittered exponential backoff, max attempts, retry predicates) and a language-level shim for integrating existing credential refresh hooks. 2) Streaming ergonomics: async generator helpers (Python), async iterable adapters (TS), and pull-stream convenience functions (Go) that provide a single-shot reconnect handler, graceful cancellation, and checkpointed resume hints. 3) Auth interplay: default credential refresh wiring is unified so token refresh and retry windows align across SDKs; introduced a lightweight DelegatedCredProvider abstraction used by all three shims. 4) Parity fixes: normalized retry defaults for idempotent vs non-idempotent operations, clarified error types for auth failures, and fixed a bug where streaming heartbeats could suppress reconnect attempts. 5) Version bumps: Python 1.9.0, TypeScript 2.7.1, Go 1.8.0; changelogs updated with migration guidance. Migration notes: Consumers should prefer RetryFacade.presets("safe"|"balanced"|"aggressive") when instantiating clients. Existing constructors retain current behavior via a compatibility shim for one release. Streaming helpers are opt-in; existing callback-based streams remain supported. Testing and CI: multi-stage matrix covering py/ts/go unit and integration tests; flaky streaming test in TS was quarantined and then fixed. See CI summary below. Follow-ups: add telemetry hooks for retry buckets (ENG-4531), expand docs with cross-language examples (PM-324), and consider a server-side hint protocol for better resume safety (research ticket).
